description: Claude Code containment guard: once a /deepmodebot: command runs in a session, Write, Edit and NotebookEdit outside the project root are denied for the rest of that session, resumes included (shell commands, natural-language triggers, and Codex apply_patch are not intercepted by this hook). Without Python 3.8+ on PATH the guard fails closed and denies those writes in active sessions.

hooks.command: d="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA:-${CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR:-$HOME/.claude}/deepmodebot-guard}"; for f in "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-/nonexistent}/skills/deepmodebot/assets/contain/claude-guard.sh" "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.claude/skills/deepmodebot/assets/contain/claude-guard.sh"; do [ -f "$f" ] && exec "${BASH:-bash}" "$f" activate "$d"; done; exit 0

d="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA:-${CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR:-$HOME/.claude}/deepmodebot-guard}"; for f in "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-/nonexistent}/skills/deepmodebot/assets/contain/claude-guard.sh" "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.claude/skills/deepmodebot/assets/contain/claude-guard.sh"; do [ -f "$f" ] && exec "${BASH:-bash}" "$f" if-active "$d"; done; exit 0
